sources.title: Map Notes and Comments, Hull-House Maps and Papers
sources.use: Printed pages4/6: predominantly frame cross-street dwellings, some brick shops, rear houses and individual passages; no public alley between Polk and Ewing. Page8 explains the outline-map base and household coloring; extracted text reviewed.
sources.rights: Original 1895 US publication, public domain by age. Full PDF remains an ignored research cache.
